verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is a documented caching read-replica layer that SDKs connect to. It is built to keep working if the connection to the Unleash server is lost, and it evaluates targeting data locally without sending it upstream, which covers both offline resilience and keeping SDK traffic in-network. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior, explicit documentation of deploying Edge inside a private network, clarity on whether the 'Enterprise Edge' naming restricts availability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network

citations.quote: Edge is designed to survive restarts and maintain functionality even if you lose connection to your Unleash server.
functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
Unleash Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer designed to improve scalability, performance, and resilience.
